attributes: /// `while n < 3 { body }` where `n` is a counter loop: the guard is the loop bound, so the body
/// hangs directly under the loop, as in `for n in 1..=3`.

manual_rationale.reason: One && in the find closure, one in counts, and six contiguous && operators in ok. Three separate same-operator runs contribute one COG each; closure nesting adds no boolean surcharge.
The let-else is inside the guard closure at nesting1; ordinary return adds nothing.
Exactly three authored ? operators; Option-returning closures remain part of this owner.
matches! expansion contributes no hidden selection; other closures/calls contain no extra authored decisions.
CC base1; total13 is strictly above12, COG5 is below12.
One top-level match has eleven alternatives; patterns and constructor fields do not add paths.
The authored if in the Ref alternative is at nesting1: COG2; its else adds COG1. This if is outside format!.
format! expansions are opaque, including recursive-looking self.render inside format!; no hidden call or branch increment.
TotalCC12 is allowed by the strict-greater-than default threshold.

Three authored self.render calls are direct recursion; the documented existing collector adds one COG each. C42 frozen label omitted them. C56 recorded saved7 versus frozen4; this new label explicitly corrects that reviewed source-label omission, without rewriting the original cases or results.

attributes: /// `if x == 3`: the comparison with a literal is the pattern of a match arm, not structure.
/// The branch is then a decision on `x` alone.

manual_rationale.reason: The let-else is in the filter_map closure at nesting1.
Three alternatives produce two CC; selection is at nesting1 inside filter_map, so COG2.
Two guards are inside alternatives at nesting2; each contributes CC1 and COG3.
One && in is_eq and three in the final condition; two same-operator runs produce COG2. Ordinary ! and method calls add nothing.
CC10, COG12; equality at12 is allowed, so neither rule finds a violation.
